resources.string: Changes apply from the next recording. If transcription gets worse on your phone, set noise cancellation to Standard.

string-array.name: mic_input_entries
string-array.item: Phone microphone only (default; Bluetooth is never used)
Bluetooth headset (falls back to the phone)
Wired or USB headset (falls back to the phone)

string-array.name: mic_noise_entries
string-array.item: Maximum: call-grade noise cancellation, noise suppressor and rumble filter
Standard: noise suppressor and rumble filter

string-array.name: mic_boost_entries
string-array.item: Maximum: up to +30 dB, never clipped
